description.description: One or two sentences: what the learner will be able to do.

id.description: Pack id = folder name: lowercase latin letters, digits, dashes, up to 40 characters. Permanent: idea codes and progress depend on it.

definition.description: One sentence: the idea in plain words (used by search).

id.description: Idea slug, unique in its topic. The idea code is `<pack>.<topic>/<idea>` and never changes — progress is keyed by it.

lesson.description: Lesson text in Markdown, 300–8000 characters. Math in KaTeX: `$…$` inline, `$$…$$` display. In JSON, backslashes are doubled: `\\frac`.

lesson_file.description: Instead of `lesson`: a Markdown file inside the pack folder, e.g. `lessons/negation.md` (single backslashes there).

level.description: 1 basic, 2 standard, 3 hard. A lesson is worth 3 + 3·level XP.

questions.description: 3–8 multiple-choice questions. Lessons ask them in order; reviews and quizzes draw from them.

requires.description: Ideas that must be learned before this one (they gate the lesson), with encompassing weights.

uses.description: Ideas this one exercises without needing them first: solving this lesson counts as partial review of them. Never gates.

code.description: Code of an existing idea in this or another loaded pack (`fire search` finds them).

key.description: Requires only: the main prerequisite. If this lesson is failed, key prerequisites are scheduled for review at once.

w.description: Encompassing weight 0.05–1: what share of a review of that idea a correct solve of this one counts as. See the rubric below.

id.description: Topic slug, unique in the pack. The topic code is `<pack>.<topic>`.

ideas.description: Lessons (ideas) in teaching order: earlier ones are offered first.

explanation.description: Why the answer is right and the common mistake is wrong; shown after answering.

options.description: 3–6 distinct options. Put the correct one at different positions across questions.
